description: Verify the configured beliq API key and report the plan, the remaining quota, and whether the key is live or a blq_test_ sandbox key, whose generated and converted documents are sandbox specimens. Calls GET /v1/me, which draws no quota. Use it as a connection and credential smoke test.
name: beliq_check_account

livemode.description: False for a blq_test_ sandbox key, true for any other key.

title: beliq: Check Account
